summaryVi: It is/was … that/who … để nhấn một phần câu (người, thời gian, lý do, v.v.).

rows.pattern: It + is/was + [phần nhấn] + that/who + mệnh đề còn lại

example.en: It was John who called you.
example.vi: Chính John đã gọi cho bạn.

rows.pattern: Người → who; vật / thời gian / lý do → that (hoặc when / where / because).

example.en: It was in 2020 that we met.
example.vi: Chính năm 2020 chúng tôi gặp nhau.

items.en: It is honesty that matters most.
items.vi: Chính sự trung thực mới quan trọng nhất.

items.en: It was because of the rain that we cancelled the trip.
items.vi: Chính vì mưa mà chúng tôi hủy chuyến đi.

exercises.prompt: It ___ Maria who solved the problem.
exercises.explanationVi: Quá khứ: It was Maria who...

exercises.prompt: It was the manager ___ I wanted to speak to.
It is hard work ___ makes you succeed.

exercises.answer: It was Tom who broke the window.

exercises.source: We discussed the plan last night.
exercises.answer: It was last night that we discussed the plan.

exercises.promptVi: Chính tiếng Anh là thứ tôi cần luyện.
exercises.answer: It is English that I need to practice.

exercises.sentence: It was her [which] told me the news.

options: It was in Hanoi which we first met.
It was in Hanoi that we first met.
It was in Hanoi when we first met.
exercises.answer: It was in Hanoi that we first met.

exercises.prompt: It ___ (be) your support that helped me most.

exercises.answer: It is more time that she needs.
exercises.explanationVi: It is more time that she needs.

exercises.promptVi: Chính anh ấy đã quên cuộc hẹn.
exercises.answer: It was he who forgot the appointment.

exercises.sentence: It is patience [what] counts in this job.
